messages:
maya: heads-up team  we want a coordinated X + LinkedIn schedule for the product launch webinar (next Tue). Need captions, platform hero crops, and seed routing plan by EOD tomorrow.

leo: Ill draft 3 caption angles: 'product outcome', 'benchmark CTA', 'playbook invite'. Will export LN hero (16:9 + overlay) and X hero (1:1 bold).

maya: captions must include short benchmark copy (placeholder if needed), e.g. '~2x throughput, ~40% less per-token cost' — product to confirm exacts. Also make a 280-char opener for the X thread.

ash: Scheduling suggestion: primary post 11am PT, 24hr reminder, and 2hr pre-show bump. Paid will boost the primary and reminder.

rachel: For link tracking use utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_may2024. Add ?seed=NAME for seeded cohorts. SDRs: tag CRM source as social_x for X leads and social_ln for LinkedIn.

sdr-bot: (automated) On signup, will post: 'New webinar registrant  campaign: launch_may2024  seed: <if any>' to #sdr-inbound and list first five.

leo: Ill drop assets in /marketing/launch/assets and include alt text + contrast notes.

maya: need 2 quick DM templates for registrants via X. Keep them conversational and 1-2 lines.

ash: DM A (registered): 'Hey {{first_name}}  thanks for registering! What use-case are you most keen on? Reply and well send tailored clips.'

ash: DM B (no-show): 'Sorry we missed you live, {{first_name}}  we shared the recording + notes. Anything you want us to highlight in a follow-up?'

rachel: analytics: create event thread_click with tweet_id param and seed param to map caption -> conversions. Also capture paid vs organic flag.

maya: final deliverables by EOD tomorrow: captions final, assets uploaded, UTMs confirmed, seedlist mapped in doc, SDR DM templates in handoff. Ill post the live schedule in #marketing at 9am the day of. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
